title: alectra arachidis
intro: Alectra arachidis, commonly known as Alectra vogelii or cowpea joyweed, is a flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Alectra arachidis include antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
